newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Telstra vote delayed until Monday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Telstra vote delayed until Monday.

text.p: The Australian Senate has stopped considering the bill to partially privatise telecoms carrier Telstra Corp and officials do not expect the upper house to return to it until Monday.
"We will not return to it now unless there is a change of programme," a government Senate official said. The Senate is due to adjourn later on Thursday and then resume on Monday.

The government wants to sell a third of Telstra for about A$8 billion. Since the government is two votes short of a majority in the Senate, the two Independents will determine whether the bill passes. All other non-government senators are opposed to the privatisation.
Earlier, the bill made some progress in the Senate, passing the second-reading debate stage with Independent backing.
It has stopped part-way through the amendment stage, the committee of the whole.
